title: The Trash of the Resurrection
paragraphs: “Jack, huh. A talking compact… Since I figured they weren’t going to give it to Filo and the others, I thought they’d name it something like ‘Heart-Pounding☆Compact’ or ‘Doppel’—something like that, based on the ‘D’ in ‘Dragon’.”
‘I hate that name! Gyaa!’
“True… You and I seem like we’d get along, don’t we?”
“Well, I guess they left it with you to watch over things while the decoder’s away. He really is the kind of guy who goes out of his way to be considerate.”
“I know he’s looking out for me, but…”
That’s the kind of look the Assistant has as he beats around the bush.
“Shouldn’t you just reject him with a look of utter contempt? Like, ‘You’re not my little sister!’ or something?”
It’s tough for me to be rejected by my Father. No matter what, he’s a kind man, so he doesn’t really reject me from the bottom of his heart.
“It’s not quite that extreme… I see her as separate from my sister, but I don’t… exactly hate her.”
“She’s a Loop User, too. It’s hard to gauge the right distance, but since she’s not doing it out of malice, it’s the kind of situation that’s just a hassle. I get where you’re coming from.”
“I wish Naofumi-sama would try to gauge the distance between us a little better, though.”
While petting his Big Sister, my Father is sympathizing with the Assistant.
“Raph.”
“You know, in Raphtalia’s case, ‘Raph Girl of Love and Courage’ might be better than ‘Melphiro’ or ‘Metal Brainwashed Warrior.’”
“Was that conversation still going on!?”
Anyway, it was decided that a talking compact—acting as a monitor—would be added to the Assistant’s chest.

That night… while I was out for a walk, the compact floated away and flew toward Father’s house, so I chased after it. It seems it had arrived after my assistant had gone to sleep. Then, with tears streaming down its face, the compact confessed that it was my assistant’s parent—and my rival’s parent as well.

Before it knew it, it had been forced into this outfit, bound by some mysterious Magic, and made into my assistant’s guardian spirit, or so it said. My Father remarked that it probably wanted to show you how well my assistant was growing up.

We also discussed that, since he knew I and my Rival would use our knowledge to escape, he might have intended to prevent us from running away. What’s more, my Rival has imbued this compact with a significant amount of the Dragon Emperor’s Core Stone’s power, so when the Assistant transforms, her power is boosted to an incredible degree. Furthermore, it’s equipped with a function that allows the compact to transform the Assistant at will, and it’s said to possess enough power to avert mortal danger even in a pinch.
“All things considered, Wyndia must be an important older sister to the decoder… since she’s even sealing away someone perfect to watch the place while she’s away.”
“Even if you’re a girl from another world, don’t seal me away in a place like this!”

She’s huffing and puffing in anger, but you don’t have a shred of dignity left, do you? Actually, isn’t this a compromise that lets her stay with her Assistant without parasitizing either her Rival or her male Rival? With that thought in mind, it seems the Assistant has become the new Melphilo and will occasionally be working alongside her Finacée and Filo-tan.
“Well then, once the wave subsides, I won’t run into any Rivals on this loop!”
Anyway… that noisy guy is gone now. From here on out, a leisurely and enjoyable life with my Father, Filo-tan, and Filolial-sama is about to begin.
“It seems you had plans to go home, though?”
“Aren’t you going to come back on the wave too?”
“Then I’ll end that wave immediately and trap you all in there!”
“I really can’t tell if you and the decoder are on good terms or bad…”
“Surely the Spear Hero… Naofumi-sama, please stop petting me whenever you get the chance.”
That Big Sister is currently in her Beastman form at my Father’s request.
“Ah, sorry about that. It just slipped out.”
“No… well, it’s fine, but let’s get back to the topic. Since you surely know what the Spear Hero is thinking, wouldn’t he come back using a different method?”
“That sounds likely… He probably didn’t tell us his plan because he knew we’d shut it down if he did.”
Dammit… Rival! So you’ve been running wild using knowledge you gained from another world, have you? Well then, go hold your head high in that world!
“The Spear Guy—you really stuck around, even though you hate Gaelion, didn’t you?”
“He’s the one who got involved, Filo-tan.”
“Hmm… but Gaelion—he was the one who taught the Spear Guy how to make Filo fly, wasn’t he?”
“Filo-tan. He’s a dragon, you know.”
“Yeah. I hate dragons. But saying ‘thank you’ is important, right?”
Oh… Filo-tan, how merciful you are. You never forget to show respect, even when dealing with a dragon. It’s truly refreshing.
“So lovely~”
“Today’s snack is pudding.”
“Yay!”
I take it out of my spear and hold it out to Filo-tan. She takes the pudding and flies off right away.

“By the way, where are Ren and Itsuki wandering off to? I haven’t seen them around lately. Well, I suppose they’re off doing hero stuff somewhere anyway… Seriously, I wish they’d join us at least during the wave season.”

Ever since Ren—and now Itsuki, too—finished their training, they’ve been heading out more often. Still, they do come to the village quite often. But… you’re right, I haven’t seen them lately. To be specific, I don’t recall seeing them since around the time our Rival went to that other world. That said, I’ve heard rumors, so I’m sure they’re having a blast with Fleon-chan and Black Thunder.
“Motoyasu-sama! Let’s go to the Pass later! I want to learn the secret technique for running faster, taught directly by the Sage!”

Lately, Yuki-chan has been eager to go for a drive with me. By the way, “the Pass” is the term I coined for driving with Filolial-sama. Incidentally, Yuki-chan absolutely loves striking that “beauty looking back” pose.
“Since things are going smoothly, the decoder went to the other world… but is there anything for me to do over here?”
“Most of it’s been taken care of. We’ve almost completely eradicated the reincarnated ones. There are just a few missing ones we’ve identified from previous loops.”

It’s rare for them to die alone out in the wilderness, but it does happen. Things like reincarnated ones killing each other, you know. When that happens, it means they should be there, but we just can’t figure out where.
“I see. By the way, Motoyasu, isn’t there a way to increase the number of Raphs? Like, perhaps applying the transformation to monsters in the village who want to become Raphs?”
“My Father from the first world used to do that.”
“…Naofumi-sama?”
Kill intent! An immense wave of kill intent is radiating from my Big Sister. Her tail is puffing up, after all.
“Raphtalia.”
Raphtalia spread her arms wide, as if to soothe Big Sister.
“What is it, Raphtalia? Do you want me to pet you some more?”

As if he didn’t sense any killing intent at all, Father began petting Big Sister—even though she was supposed to be threatening him. The moment he did, her killing intent instantly subsided. Her tail is wagging from side to side.
“Ugh… I-I simply cannot back down on this one. Lord Naofumi! If you don’t stop this, I’ll get angry too. Are you even listening, Lord Naofumi?!”

Big Sister reignites the anger that had dissipated under his strokes and scolds him, but the murderous intent she had shown earlier has vanished, and Father just keeps petting her, as if he’s not listening at all. He looks so gentle as he does that.
“Oh my—I’m so jealous of you, Big Sister. Raph-chan, maybe I should ask you to Class Up me too. I wonder what’ll happen to me then?”
“Raph—”
“Sadeena, please don’t jump on the bandwagon!”
Big Sister’s older sister, who had been silently watching, tried to join in on the exchange between my Father and Big Sister.
“My Big Sister’s Big Sister… was modified by my Father—who’d gone a bit mad after creating the Raph species—so she could transform into a Raph-like beast that looked like a sea lion.”
“Does it not matter what kind of Raph fur it is?”
“Even though she was supposed to have been cured and unable to transform anymore, it really stuck with me how my Big Sister’s Big Sister would sometimes transform just for fun.”
“Oh my… that sounds like fun.”
“Naofumi-sama! Please, for heaven’s sake, don’t do that for real!”
“It’s not that extreme. If I do it, I’ll make sure I end up looking more like Raphtalia.”
“Please don’t do that either!”
And just like that, we wrapped up the peaceful gathering and went our separate ways.
That evening… a messenger arrived from Melromarc Castle via my Finacée.
“Naofumi! And you, Spear Hero!”
“What is it, Melty? Did you come to practice dancing or something with Filo? Or is this about the third ‘Merphilo’?”
“What do you think I am, Naofumi?!”
“What do you mean…? Merphi—the righteous warrior who fights evil while serving as lord in place of the female knight—”
“I can’t hear you! Listen to me instead!”
My finacée—who’s been putting on shows with Filo-tan to liven up the domain of my Father—arrived looking quite distressed.
“My Father slipped out of the castle and has gone missing!”
“What!?”
At that moment, Tiger Guy—who’d been standing nearby, seemingly left out of the commotion—stepped forward and asked,
“What’s happened to Atla!”
“Don’t worry, she’s fine. Atla is at the castle.”
“Did Trash run away? Did she show her true colors?”

“I can’t really say… Lately, even while wearing the costumes and carrying the signs that Mother imposed as punishment—which should only bring her humiliation—she’s been walking around with a dignified expression, not just inside the castle but also in the town below. People were even starting to say things like, ‘The queen who’s making my father suffer like this is in the wrong…’”
“…I rarely went to the castle, so I don’t know much about it, but what the hell are your parents doing?”
They’re a spectacle! Just the kind of thing people point and laugh at! HAHAHA!
“It looks like this might indirectly tarnish my reputation… So, what exactly happened when that Trash ran off?”

“I didn’t hear the story firsthand either, but apparently, when Father said he was leaving, the guarding soldiers were so overwhelmed by his commanding presence—the kind that draws people in—that they just let him go. He told Atla, ‘I’m going out to atone for my sins,’ and then he left… and never came back…”
“Tch! This is turning into a real hassle… I’m heading to the castle to talk to the Queen. Motoyasu, has anything like this ever happened in the loops so far?”
“It has. It was the loop where that Trash teamed up with Takt to cause trouble and take revenge on me and my Father!”
He’s finally shown his true colors! This time, I’ll make sure he gets what he deserves! However, my Father’s expression turned serious.
“…As Melty said, it’s hard to say for sure. I just hope nothing strange happens… Raphtalia, Fohl.”
“Yes!”
“Atla!”
And so, we hurried straight to Melromarc Castle via a portal. Of course, my Finacée came along too.
“Mother!”
The queen greeted us as we arrived in the throne room.
“I heard that Trash escaped. Is that true?”
“Yes. The guard soldiers had been hiding the fact that Trash had escaped. It seems he instructed them to keep it a secret.”
“To allow an escape, of all things… It seems the knowledge of Motoyasu and his lot, as well as the Queen’s trust, are surprisingly useless after all.”

“I have no words to say in my defense. I, too, misjudged that Trash would resort to such an outrageous act. We’re interrogating the soldier who aided his escape, but he insists he has no regrets, claiming he was swayed by Trash’s charisma… It seems he let him go knowing he’d be punished, and Trash understood that and fled accordingly…”

No matter how much he suffers, Trash is a man who values his family above all else. He never strays from the Queen’s side—except when seeking revenge for the Crimson Swine killed right before his eyes. Even in the face of punishment, that never changed. Still, security in this country really is a sieve, isn’t it?
“…So, what’s Trash’s objective? Is it revenge against us?”
Some time later, my Father told me what he’d been thinking about here. Apparently, he suspected that either Trash had realized I’d poisoned the Crimson Swine, or that someone had whispered it to him.

“No… that’s probably not the case. Every day, whenever Trash saw me, he’d say with great conviction and a look on his face as if recalling the past, ‘Is there anything I can do? Lord Iwatani, can I be of service to you and the heroes?’ And in his hand, the Seven Star Weapons—the staff—was shining……”
“The Seven Star Weapons?”

“Yes… The staff that had vanished from Trash’s hands—hands hardened by hatred toward the Demi-Humans—has reappeared and is lending him power… I cannot fathom what this means. However, perhaps we should act as if he were the Wise King at the height of his wisdom.”
“I’m not quite sure how far that goes… Motoyasu, do you understand?”
“Well… if the staff has appeared, that basically means he’s undefeated in battle.”

At least, among the Trash I know, the only ones who’ve wielded the staff are the one from the first world and the one from the loop where we saved Big Sister’s friend. The others haven’t even gotten to the point of bringing out the staff yet. Plus, since they weren’t enemies in any of those worlds, how strong they’d be if they turned against us is anyone’s guess.
But the Seven Star Weapons made a huge mistake, didn’t it? This Trash from this loop is heartbroken. I’m going to finish him off right here! His successor will surely be the Queen!
“Unbeaten in strategy… huh.”

“If we were to face him as an enemy… there’s no doubt we’d suffer significant damage. Given the Trash’s personality, Iwatan-sama, please stay with Melty at all times to protect yourself. The Trash is someone who cherishes his family deeply, so he probably won’t make any rash moves.”
“How much can we trust him…? No, rather, can we even understand that part?”
Father looked at Big Sister and nodded.
“Naofumi-sama? That’s not Raph-chan, is it?”
Big Sister is clearly consumed by suspicion. I’m sure Father is genuinely worried about her.
“As for other clues, according to Atla, there was a witness who saw someone talking to a strong-looking person by the window.”
“A mysterious accomplice, huh…”
“The report says the voice belonged to a girl.”
“A girl. That’s a pretty unsettling vibe… Wait, by the window?”
If it were Fleon-chan, it would be a sure thing, but that’s not the case, is it? There must have been someone who scaled the tower. It probably wasn’t that difficult.
Staff…100%
